{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
df_mean = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()

# Print the mean flipper lengths for each species with full precision
print(df_mean)

# Extract and print each mean explicitly
adelaide_mean = df_mean[df_mean['species'] == 'Adelie']['flipper_length_mm'].values[0]
chinstrap_mean = df_mean[df_mean['species'] == 'Chinstrap']['flipper_length_mm'].values[0]
gentoo_mean = df_mean[df_mean['species'] == 'Gentoo']['flipper_length_mm'].values[0]

print(f"Mean flipper length for Adelie: {adelaide_mean}")
print(f"Mean flipper length for Chinstrap: {chinstrap_mean}")
print(f"Mean flipper length for Gentoo: {gentoo_mean}")

# Identify the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = df_mean.loc[df_mean['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax(), 'species']
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}")"}
